items.question: What if my opponent cancels/we can't get a game in?
items.answer: If one player is at fault for a cancelled game they will take a game loss with 0 points. The other player will be awarded a win as if they had 66 points. If you can't schedule a game in and it's neither player's fault, you can agree to a draw with 33 to 33 points.

items.question: Can I change my list between rounds?
items.answer: No! Unless something big like a dataslate or new mission pack drops we'll keep things the same. Your 1000 point and 2000 points lists will be able to be completely different though. They don't even have to share the same super faction.

items.question: How are we handling terrain?
items.answer: I would recommend you talk to your opponent about that and set things up as you see fit. We encourage though that you use the WTC layouts (https://worldteamchampionship.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/WTC-2025-Map-Pack-Lite-v1.2compressed.pdf) and treat your bottom floor windows as blocking LOS. I've made some terrain footprint mats out of clear plastic and added them to various terrain sets at Guf Werribee to help facilitate this.

items.question: How are standings handled?
items.answer: Your standings will primarily be based on W/L/D record. The next tie breaker will be point differentials (how much you beat your opponent by, so make sure to deny those last minute primary points). Then if needed strength of schedule is used. Essentially, you'll be rated slightly higher based on how strong your opponents were.

items.question: Is this a narrative event?
items.answer: No. I'm sure we'll forge our own narratives through this, and tell some fun stories, but there is no narrative or crusade elements to this league. At its core, it's just straight up matched play. I'm sure I'll write some fun fluff about the Chaeos Cult but doing the same for your army is not a requirement nor an expectation.

items.question: When is the cut-off point?
items.answer: You can sign up any time during the six weeks. We recommend starting within the first two weeks.

items.question: Do I need to paint a Warhammer model?
items.answer: No — any brand/range is fine if purchased via Guf Werribee and follows restrictions.

items.question: Is there a minimum painting standard?
items.answer: No enforcement, but we recommend the "Strict" standard: at least three colours, painted base.

items.question: Do I have to paint purple?
What if the model doesn't come with a base?
items.answer: It must still fit within a 65mm footprint. Contact TOs if unsure.

items.question: Can I mount my model on an alternative base?
items.answer: Yes, but the base must match the intended size of the supplied base.

items.question: What happens if I don't follow guidelines?
items.answer: Your piece won't be eligible for prizes. Check with TOs if unsure.

items.question: Can I buy a kit with multiple models and enter one?
items.answer: Yes — you may enter a single model from a multi-kit box, but customization must use only parts from that model.

items.question: Can I use bits from other kits for basing?
items.answer: No — only tufts/flock/basing materials allowed. Exception: plastic basing kits (Citadel Skulls/Vines) are fine.

items.title: Brushwork & Execution
items.description: Technical skill. Judges look for smooth blends, sharp edge highlights, precise Non-Metallic Metal (NMM) or True Metallic Metal (TMM), and no unintended brush strokes or texture

items.title: Colour Theory & Scheme
items.description: How the colours work together, including contrast (light vs dark, warm vs cool), saturation, and how the scheme draws the eye to the focal point

items.title: Basing & Environment
items.description: The base should complement the miniature, not distract from it. Judges look for cohesive environmental storytelling, realistic textures (mud, water, pigments) and a cleanly finished rim

items.title: Creativity & Conversions
items.description: Imagination. This covers freehand, kitbashing (combining parts from different kits) and scratch-built elements that take the model beyond its stock pose

items.title: Craftsmanship & Cleanliness
items.description: Build quality. Judges will deduct points for visible mould lines, gaps, or leftover sprue marks
